description: This file is a Bash script used for setting up, configuring, and executing end-to-end tests of the OpenClaw project. It manages environment setup, version resolution, model configuration, tool fixtures, and orchestrates a sequence of interactions with the OpenClaw system to verify its functionality across different models and configurations.

methods.name: set_image_model
methods.description: Sets the image model for the OpenClaw profile, trying multiple candidates until one succeeds.

methods.name: set_agent_model
methods.description: Sets the agent model for the OpenClaw profile, trying multiple candidates until one succeeds.

methods.name: write_png_lr_rg
methods.description: Generates a PNG image file with a left-right colored pattern, used as a fixture in testing.

methods.name: run_agent_turn
methods.description: Runs an agent turn with a specified prompt and saves the output to a JSON file.

methods.name: assert_agent_json_has_text
methods.description: Checks if the agent's JSON output contains any text payloads.

methods.name: assert_agent_json_ok
methods.description: Verifies that the agent's JSON output has a successful status and no errors, optionally checking provider.

methods.name: extract_matching_text
methods.description: Extracts a specific text from the agent's JSON transcript, matching expected value.

methods.name: assert_session_used_tools
methods.description: Analyzes a session transcript JSONL file to ensure certain tools were used during the interaction.

methods.name: run_profile
methods.description: Orchestrates setup, health check, interaction, and verification steps for a specific OpenClaw profile, including model configuration, gateway launch, agent interactions, and cleanup.
